name: devplan
description: Product intelligence for software teams, powered by your Devplan workspace. Four dashboards refreshed twice every weekday: a Daily Radar tailored to you, Execution Monitoring with slipped work and a searchable changelog, a Demand Report with customer promises, market moves and suggested projects, and Engineering Analytics. Plan cycles from your team's real pace, and write specs that are tracked in Devplan automatically. Requires a Devplan account; setup walks you through creating one.

interface.longDescription:
Devplan turns your customer asks, team decisions, and shipped work into pre-computed knowledge, so your agents complete work correctly the first time. It reads your code, tickets, Slack, docs, calls and support, and keeps a live map of your product: what exists, what's shipping, what customers ask for, and what was decided.

This plugin brings that map into ChatGPT and Codex. Setup builds four dashboards in one Devplan Site and refreshes them twice every weekday: Your daily radar, Execution Monitoring across Devplan, Linear and Jira with what slipped and a searchable changelog, a Demand Report with customer promises, market moves and suggested projects, and Engineering Analytics.

Plan a cycle from your team's real pace, choosing between a few strategic directions. Write specs with a short discovery conversation, a technical plan and an estimate, and every spec is tracked in Devplan automatically. Ask any product or technical question, here or in Slack, and get answers that cite the PRs, tickets, calls and decisions behind them.

Requires a Devplan account. Setup walks you through creating one and connecting your sources.
defaultPrompt: What are customers asking for that we haven't planned?
